title: A Tough Ad Reminds Nebraska Voters About a Brutal Crime and a Pardon
summary: A group supporting Dan Osborn, the independent Senate candidate in Nebraska, is airing an ad attacking Senator Pete Ricketts, a Republican, for pardoning a man convicted of sexual assault.
